vocab.definition: a single element or compound, not mixed.
a useful mixture made to an exact recipe.
a pure substance melts at one sharp temperature.
lowers melting point and widens the range.

misconceptions.right: In chemistry pure means a single substance.
Impurities lower it and spread it over a range.

misconceptions.wrong: A formulation is a pure substance.
misconceptions.right: A formulation is a carefully made mixture.

infoPanels.title: PURE vs IMPURE
workedSteps: !Pure substances have a fixed melting point.
An impurity lowers and broadens the melting point.
Each component has a measured amount and purpose.

questions.text: State what a chemist means by a pure substance. [1 mark]
Explain how a melting point test shows whether a substance is pure. [2 marks]
State what is meant by a formulation and give an example. [2 marks]
Describe how an impurity changes the melting point. [2 marks]
Complete the sentence using the word bank. [2 marks]
questions.secondaryText: A pure substance melts at a ______ temperature; an impurity melts over a ______.

questions.text: Give two everyday formulations and their purpose. [2 marks]

footer.tip: Pure = one substance, sharp melting point. Impure = melts over a range.
footer.thinkPrompt: Why is a carefully measured recipe so important in a medicine formulation?
